cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Emotional Interest
cards.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I told your mother I'm scared she dislikes me. Sunday, you owe me an equally embarrassing admission.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't ask you to tell her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I trusted you to risk something too. What scares you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's equal. Now tell her over lunch. Mine had an audience; yours needs one too.
